title: QOpenHD Advanced menu tree

snapshot.basis: Source inventory of this local checkout; no connected-device snapshot.
snapshot.mode: Enable advanced settings ON (both developer flags true)

reading_notes: Advanced settings ON. Every fallback parameter and its choices/range is expanded in the text reference section, including hidden parameters. Additional firmware IDs are listed separately with evidence.

Advanced settings ON. Every fallback parameter and its choices/range is expanded in the text reference section, including hidden parameters. Additional firmware IDs are listed separately with evidence.
English UI labels. Settings and actions retain source file/line references. QML expressions describe platform, developer-mode and hardware conditions.
Fixed QML options and numeric ranges are included. dynamic_model means choices are populated at runtime. Conditional labels separated by / represent alternate UI text.

Device metadata replaces the local fallback catalog. Air/Ground/camera menus can expose additional firmware parameters, choices and groups. No static source tree can enumerate every possible firmware response.
This is the Advanced menu scope, including dialogs it opens. Widget-local detail popups on the flight HUD are outside this menu.
Camera catalog_parameter_candidates show conditional placement, not guaranteed hardware availability. Ranges are control limits; current values are not captured.

VARIABLE_BITRATE.description: Recommend a matching bitrate to the encoder depending on the selected link parameters,and reduce bitrate on TX errors (failed injections). On by default, but only works on select cameras. On Cameras thatdon't support changing the bitrate / are bad at targeting a given bitrate, you have to adjust your link according to your camera needs.
VARIABLE_BITRATE.label: VARIABLE_BITRATE

QP_MAX.description: Maximum encoder QP. Lower values improve quality but increase required bitrate.
QP_MAX.label: QP_MAX

QP_MIN.description: Minimum encoder QP. Higher values reduce bitrate but can reduce image quality.
QP_MIN.label: QP_MIN

WB_E_STBC.description: !! Advanced users only, changing this param can result in no connection !!. This param is not automatically synchronized between air/ground. Specifies the difference between the number of space-time streams and the number of spatial streams. Use +1 only if you have 2 antennas.
WB_E_STBC.label: WB_E_STBC

WB_E_LDPC.description: !! Advanced users only, changing this param can result in no connection !!. This param is not automatically synchronized between air/ground. Enable Low density parity check. Needs to be supported by both your tx and rxes.
WB_E_LDPC.label: WB_E_LDPC

WB_E_SHORT_GUARD.description: !! Advanced users only !!. This param is not automatically synchronized between air/ground. A short guard intervall increases throughput, but increases packet collisions.
WB_E_SHORT_GUARD.label: WB_E_SHORT_GUARD

ESP_ANALYSE.description: Use the connected ESP background RF survey for analysis and prioritize air discovery. Legacy scanning remains the fallback.
ESP_ANALYSE.label: ESP_ANALYSE

WB_PASSIVE_MODE.description: Enable passive mode if you want to use your GCS as a passive listener to an existing openhd air-ground link. E.g. if you want to tune intosomeone elses openhd link (if encryption is enabled, you need his encryption key) but not interfere with any RC/MAVLINK control.
WB_PASSIVE_MODE.label: WB_PASSIVE_MODE

WB_PIT_MODE.description: Pit mode: when enabled, disarmed uses the 20% TX power target and armed uses the selected target.
WB_PIT_MODE.label: WB_PIT_MODE

DEV_HIGH_RETR.description: DEV ONLY - DO NOT TOUCH (LEAVE DISABLED). Sets a wifi param that needs to be investigated.
DEV_HIGH_RETR.label: DEV_HIGH_RETR

WB_RED_TX.description: Send packets redundantly on all connected TX cards. Increases robustness but also airtime usage.
WB_RED_TX.label: WB_RED_TX

WB_ADAPT_CH.description: Use the second Devourer radio on Air to survey channels and automatically move the link when a persistently cleaner channel is found. Redundant TX is disabled while active.
WB_ADAPT_CH.label: WB_ADAPT_CH

WB_FHSS.description: Devourer frequency hopping. Devourer handles synchronization and its Wi-Fi control channel; mLRS UART or another live independent telemetry link is required as the OpenHD uplink/recovery path.
WB_FHSS.label: WB_FHSS

WB_FHSS_SLOT.description: Devourer FHSS dwell time. 50 ms is recommended.
WB_FHSS_SLOT.label: WB_FHSS_SLOT

RC_OHD_CTRL.description: Enable OpenHD settings commands from the EdgeTX/OpenTX Lua tool. The transport uses four consecutive RC channels.
RC_OHD_CTRL.label: RC_OHD_CTRL

RC_SET_BASE.description: First RC channel used by the Lua settings protocol. The mapping is D2, D1, D0 and CLK; zero disables the protocol.
RC_SET_BASE.label: RC_SET_BASE

WB_ENABLE_RETRA.description: Enable ARQ retransmission for video. Requires restart to take effect.
WB_ENABLE_RETRA.label: WB_ENABLE_RETRA

WB_RTX_VIDEO.description: Enable ARQ retransmission for video packets. Requires restart to take effect.
WB_RTX_VIDEO.label: WB_RTX_VIDEO

WB_RTX_TELEM.description: Enable ARQ retransmission for telemetry packets. Requires restart to take effect.
WB_RTX_TELEM.label: WB_RTX_TELEM

WB_RTX_RC.description: Enable ARQ retransmission for RC packets. Requires restart to take effect.
WB_RTX_RC.label: WB_RTX_RC

WB_RTX_V_MAXMS.description: Max retransmission history window for video in milliseconds. Larger values allow longer recovery but use more memory.
WB_RTX_V_MAXMS.label: WB_RTX_V_MAXMS

WB_RTX_T_MAXMS.description: Max retransmission history window for telemetry in milliseconds. Larger values allow longer recovery but use more memory.
WB_RTX_T_MAXMS.label: WB_RTX_T_MAXMS

WB_RTX_R_MAXMS.description: Max retransmission history window for RC in milliseconds. Larger values allow longer recovery but use more memory.
WB_RTX_R_MAXMS.label: WB_RTX_R_MAXMS

WB_RTX_REQ_REP.description: How often each retransmission request is sent. Higher values increase reliability but add overhead.
WB_RTX_REQ_REP.label: WB_RTX_REQ_REP

TX_POWER_I.description: Please use the TX POWER wizzard from WB Link to avoid destroying your card ! Unitless Tx power index value applied when the FC is disarmed and no specific armedtx power value is set.
TX_POWER_I.label: TX_POWER_I

TX_POWER_I_ARMED.description: Please use the TX POWER wizzard from WB Link to avoid destroying your card ! Unitless Tx power index value applied when the FC is armed, off by default
TX_POWER_I_ARMED.label: TX_POWER_I_ARMED

TX_POWER_MW.description: Please use the TX POWER wizzard from WB Link to avoid destroying your card ! tx power in mW when FC is disarmed and no specific armed tx power value is set. Actual tx power depends on the manufacturer.
TX_POWER_MW.label: TX_POWER_MW

TX_POWER_MW_ARM.description: Please use the TX POWER wizzard from WB Link to avoid destroying your card ! tx power in mW when FC is armed, off by default. Actual tx power depends on the manufacturer.
TX_POWER_MW_ARM.label: TX_POWER_MW_ARM

TX_PWR_LVL.description: Normalized TX power target. Values through 100% use the normal calibrated range. Values above 100% are hardware-stressing Devourer overdrive and require Advanced Settings in the link control.
TX_PWR_LVL.label: TX_PWR_LVL

WB_V_FEC_BLK_L.description: Default AUTO (Uses biggest block sizes possible while not adding any latency).Otherwise: WB Video FEC block length, previous FEC_K. Increasing this value can improve link stability for free, but can create additional latency.
WB_V_FEC_BLK_L.label: WB_V_FEC_BLK_L

WB_V_RATE_PERC.description: Reduce used data rate per mcs index by fixed value (not needed in most cases)
WB_V_RATE_PERC.label: WB_V_RATE_PERC

WB_V_FEC_PERC.description: WB Video FEC overhead, in percent. Increases link stability, but also the required link bandwidth (watch out for tx errors). The best value depends on your rf environment - recommended is about ~20% in low rf enironemnts(e.g. nature), and ~50% in high rf noise environments(populated areas).Note that your rf interference/ packet loss will increase during flight, it is not recommended to decrase this value below 20%.
WB_V_FEC_PERC.label: WB_V_FEC_PERC

WB_CHANNEL_W.description: !!!Editing this param manually without care will result in a broken link!!!
WB_CHANNEL_W.label: WB_CHANNEL_W

WB_MCS_INDEX.description: !!!Editing this param manually without care will result in a broken link!!!
WB_MCS_INDEX.label: WB_MCS_INDEX

MCS_VIA_RC.description: Dynamically change the MCS Index (Trade range <-> image quality (bitrate)) during flight using your RC and a specific channel (similar to how flight modes work).
MCS_VIA_RC.label: MCS_VIA_RC

BW_VIA_RC.description: Dynamically change the BW via RC. NOT ALWAYS SAFE TO USE !
BW_VIA_RC.label: BW_VIA_RC

WB_FREQUENCY.description: !!!Editing this param manually without care will result in a broken link!!!
WB_FREQUENCY.label: WB_FREQUENCY

WB_MAX_D_BZ.description: Developer only, max FEC block size.
WB_MAX_D_BZ.label: WB_MAX_D_BZ

WIFI_CARD0.description: Detected wifi card type used for wifibroadcast.
WIFI_CARD0.label: WIFI_CARD0

WIFI_CARD1.description: Detected wifi card type used for wifibroadcast.
WIFI_CARD1.label: WIFI_CARD1

WIFI_CARD2.description: Detected wifi card type used for wifibroadcast.
WIFI_CARD2.label: WIFI_CARD2

WIFI_CARD3.description: Detected wifi card type used for wifibroadcast.
WIFI_CARD3.label: WIFI_CARD3

FC_BATT_N_CELLS.description: Stored locally on your air unit. If set to a nonzero value, overwrites the batt n cells of any connected GS (QOpenHD)such that you don't have to change the value when swapping around planes.
FC_BATT_N_CELLS.label: FC_BATT_N_CELLS

FC_SYS_ID.description: MAVLink system ID of the flight controller. Avoid using 100 or 101 (reserved for OpenHD air/ground), and keep it within 1-254.
FC_SYS_ID.label: FC_SYS_ID

AR_ADDR.description: Artosyn daemon address (host/IP). Changing this reconnects to the daemon.
AR_ADDR.label: AR_ADDR

AR_SLOT.description: Artosyn slot index used by the OpenHD link.
AR_SLOT.label: AR_SLOT

AR_MCS_MD.description: MCS mode. Manual uses AR_MCS_VAL; Auto uses internal adaptation.
AR_MCS_MD.label: AR_MCS_MD

AR_MCS_VAL.description: Manual MCS value (bb_phy_mcs_e). Use -1 to keep current.
AR_MCS_VAL.label: AR_MCS_VAL

AR_MCS_MIN.description: Auto MCS minimum limit (bb_phy_mcs_e). -1 disables the limit.
AR_MCS_MIN.label: AR_MCS_MIN

AR_MCS_MAX.description: Auto MCS maximum limit (bb_phy_mcs_e). -1 disables the limit.
AR_MCS_MAX.label: AR_MCS_MAX

AR_BW_MD.description: Bandwidth mode. Manual uses AR_BW_VAL; Auto uses internal adaptation.
AR_BW_MD.label: AR_BW_MD

AR_CHN_MD.description: Channel mode. Manual uses AR_CHN_IDX; Auto uses internal adaptation.
AR_CHN_MD.label: AR_CHN_MD

AR_PWR_ATO.description: Power control mode. Manual uses AR_PWR_DBM.
AR_PWR_ATO.label: AR_PWR_ATO

AR_PWR_DBM.description: Manual TX power target (dBm). -1 keeps current.
AR_PWR_DBM.label: AR_PWR_DBM

AR_RF_ATX.description: RF path A TX enable. -1 keeps current.
AR_RF_ATX.label: AR_RF_ATX

AR_RF_ARX.description: RF path A RX enable. -1 keeps current.
AR_RF_ARX.label: AR_RF_ARX

AR_RF_BTX.description: RF path B TX enable. -1 keeps current.
AR_RF_BTX.label: AR_RF_BTX

AR_RF_BRX.description: RF path B RX enable. -1 keeps current.
AR_RF_BRX.label: AR_RF_BRX

AR_V_RX_DS.description: Video socket RX buffered data size (bytes).
AR_V_RX_DS.label: AR_V_RX_DS

AR_V_TX_DS.description: Video socket TX buffered data size (bytes).
AR_V_TX_DS.label: AR_V_TX_DS

AR_T_RX_DS.description: Telemetry socket RX buffered data size (bytes).
AR_T_RX_DS.label: AR_T_RX_DS

AR_T_TX_DS.description: Telemetry socket TX buffered data size (bytes).
AR_T_TX_DS.label: AR_T_TX_DS

RESOLUTION_FPS.description: Video WIDTHxHEIGHT@FPS. You can enter any value you want here, but if you select a video format that is not supported by your camera, the video stream will stop
RESOLUTION_FPS.label: RESOLUTION_FPS

IP_CAM_PIPELINE.description: GStreamer source pipeline for an IP camera. Use {IP} for IP_CAM_ADDRESS and {CODEC} for h264/h265 from VIDEO_CODEC; limited to 127 characters.
IP_CAM_PIPELINE.label: IP_CAM_PIPELINE

IP_CAM_ADDRESS.description: IPv4 address of this IP camera. OpenHD adds a secondary local /24 address when required without replacing the normal Ethernet configuration.
IP_CAM_ADDRESS.label: IP_CAM_ADDRESS

VIDEO_CODEC.description: Video codec. If your camera/ground station does not support HW accelerated encoding/decoding of the selected codec,it'l default to SW encode/decode. A reboot (air&ground) is recommended after changing this parameter.
VIDEO_CODEC.label: VIDEO_CODEC

LIBCAMERA_IMPL.description: Select the Raspberry Pi camera backend. Changing it restarts the camera stream.
LIBCAMERA_IMPL.label: LIBCAMERA_IMPL

ROCKCHIP_IMPL.description: Select the supported Rockchip camera backend. Changing it restarts OpenHD and the camera stream.
ROCKCHIP_IMPL.label: ROCKCHIP_IMPL

AIR_RECORDING_E.description: Record video data locally on your air unit. You can find the files under /home/openhd/Videos on the SD card and/or download them via the web ui.When AUTO is set, air recording automatically starts (and stops) when you arm/disarm your drone (requires inav / ardupilot FC).
AIR_RECORDING_E.label: Air recording

STREAMING_E.description: Enable / disable streaming for this camera. Note that this setting is persistent at run time - once you disable streaming for a camera, you won't have video until you re-enable streaming or reboot your air unit. On by default
STREAMING_E.label: Video streaming

BITRATE_MBITS.description: Camera encoder bitrate, does not include FEC overhead. !! If variable bitrate is enabled (recommended), this value is ignored.!! Otherwise, you can manually set a fixed camera/encoder bitrate here. NOTE: If you are using a camera not listed on the OpenHD recommended cameras list, the bitrate might be fixed by the vendor and not changeable.
BITRATE_MBITS.label: BITRATE_MBITS

KEYFRAME_I.description: Keyframe / instantaneous decode refresh interval, in frames. E.g. if set to 15, every 15th frame will be a key frame. Higher values result in better image compression, but increase the likeliness of microfreezes.
KEYFRAME_I.label: KEYFRAME_I

QP_PID_ENABLE.description: Enable experimental runtime QP limit PID control. OpenHD compares measured encoder bitrate against the current target bitrate and adjusts live QP min/max to reduce bitrate over/undershoot. Off by default.
QP_PID_ENABLE.label: QP_PID_ENABLE

RK_BITRATE_PID.description: Enable experimental RK3566/RK3588 MPP VBR bitrate PID control. OpenHD compares measured encoder bitrate against the current target bitrate and adjusts live encoder bps/bps-min/bps-max. On by default for RK3566/RK3588 testing.
RK_BITRATE_PID.label: RK_BITRATE_PID

FORCE_SW_ENC.description: Force SW encode for the given camera, only enable if your camera supports outputting an appropriate raw format.
FORCE_SW_ENC.label: FORCE_SW_ENC

V_SWITCH_CAM.description: Requires reboot. Switch primary and secondary camera.
V_SWITCH_CAM.label: V_SWITCH_CAM

V_PRIMARY_PERC.description: If Variable bitrate is enabled,your primary camera is given that much percentage of the total available link bandwidth. The rest is given to the secondary camera. Default to 60% (60:40 split).
V_PRIMARY_PERC.label: V_PRIMARY_PERC

V_IP_CAM_MBITS.description: Fixed link bitrate reserved for an IP camera in either slot. OpenHD cannot adjust the IP camera encoder: configure its own WebUI to stay at or below this value and keep it low.
V_IP_CAM_MBITS.label: V_IP_CAM_MBITS

ROTATION_FLIP.description: Mirror horizontally, flip vertically, or combine both into a 180-degree turn.
ROTATION_FLIP.label: ROTATION_FLIP

INTRA_REFRESH.description: Experimental,Default NONE, Type of Intra Refresh to use
INTRA_REFRESH.label: INTRA_REFRESH

BRIGHTNESS.description: Image capture brightness, [0..200], default 100. Increase for a brighter Image. However, if available, it is recommended to tune AWB or EXP instead.
BRIGHTNESS.label: BRIGHTNESS

GX_DAYNIGHT.description: GX ISP day/night mode. Drives an attached IR-cut actuator; does not control IR illumination.
GX_DAYNIGHT.label: GX_DAYNIGHT

GX_IRCUT_DIR.description: Reverse IR-cut actuator polarity to match the attached lens.
GX_IRCUT_DIR.label: GX_IRCUT_DIR

GX_IRCUT_TIMER.description: Periodically reassert the IR-cut actuator state.
GX_IRCUT_TIMER.label: GX_IRCUT_TIMER

GX_EXPOSURE.description: GX ISP control mode. Manual gain/shutter or manual WB channel gains take effect only in Manual mode.
GX_EXPOSURE.label: GX_EXPOSURE

GX_WB_MODE.description: GX ISP control mode. Manual gain/shutter or manual WB channel gains take effect only in Manual mode.
GX_WB_MODE.label: GX_WB_MODE

GX_GAIN.description: GX gain in tenths of a dB: 60 means 6.0 dB. Manual gain requires manual exposure mode. Values above 45.3 dB include digital gain.
GX_GAIN.label: GX_GAIN

GX_AE_MAX_GAIN.description: GX gain in tenths of a dB: 60 means 6.0 dB. Manual gain requires manual exposure mode. Values above 45.3 dB include digital gain.
GX_AE_MAX_GAIN.label: GX_AE_MAX_GAIN

GX_SHUTTER_US.description: Exposure time in microseconds, limited to one 30-fps frame. Manual shutter requires manual exposure mode.
GX_SHUTTER_US.label: GX_SHUTTER_US

GX_AE_MAX_US.description: Exposure time in microseconds, limited to one 30-fps frame. Manual shutter requires manual exposure mode.
GX_AE_MAX_US.label: GX_AE_MAX_US

GX_WB_RED.description: Manual white balance channel gain. Requires GX_WB_MODE=Manual.
GX_WB_RED.label: GX_WB_RED

GX_WB_BLUE.description: Manual white balance channel gain. Requires GX_WB_MODE=Manual.
GX_WB_BLUE.label: GX_WB_BLUE

GX_SATURATION.description: GX ISP image adjustment, vendor range 0-100.
GX_SATURATION.label: GX_SATURATION

GX_CONTRAST.description: GX ISP image adjustment, vendor range 0-100.
GX_CONTRAST.label: GX_CONTRAST

GX_HUE.description: GX ISP image adjustment, vendor range 0-100.
GX_HUE.label: GX_HUE

GX_AE_TARGET.description: GX ISP strength or AE brightness target, vendor range 0-255. AE target requires auto exposure mode.
GX_AE_TARGET.label: GX_AE_TARGET

GX_SHARPNESS.description: GX ISP strength or AE brightness target, vendor range 0-255. AE target requires auto exposure mode.
GX_SHARPNESS.label: GX_SHARPNESS

GX_DENOISE_2D.description: GX ISP strength or AE brightness target, vendor range 0-255. AE target requires auto exposure mode.
GX_DENOISE_2D.label: GX_DENOISE_2D

GX_DENOISE_3D.description: GX ISP strength or AE brightness target, vendor range 0-255. AE target requires auto exposure mode.
GX_DENOISE_3D.label: GX_DENOISE_3D

GX_DRC.description: GX ISP strength or AE brightness target, vendor range 0-255. AE target requires auto exposure mode.
GX_DRC.label: GX_DRC

METERING_MODE.description: Camera exposure metering mode to use. Default average.
METERING_MODE.label: METERING_MODE

DENOISE_INDEX_LC.description: Setting this to off reduces latency by ~1 Frame on the cost of slightly reduced image quality in dark situations.
DENOISE_INDEX_LC.label: DENOISE_INDEX_LC

SHUTTER_US_LC.description: Libcamera shutter in microseconds. Normally seleceted automatically, but you can overwrite this value for more control.
SHUTTER_US_LC.label: SHUTTER_US_LC

HIGH_ENCRYPTION.description: Enable ultra secure - but expensive - video encryption - by default, video is not encrypted (only validated) to save CPU performance (Telemetry is always encrypted though).It is recommended to leave video encryption off unless you are using at least RPI 4 on air and are TOTALLY worried about someone listening to your video - even with encryption disabled, it is not easy for an attacker to listen in on your openhd video (and impossible to attack your video due to always on secure packet validation).
HIGH_ENCRYPTION.label: HIGH_ENCRYPTION

ENABLE_JOY_RC.description: Only enable joystick rc if you actually use it to save cpu / bandwidth. If enabled, you can connect a joystick to your ground station for RC. After enabling,a reboot is recommended, but not neccessary.
ENABLE_JOY_RC.label: ENABLE_JOY_RC

FC_UART_FLWCTL.description: Leave disabled, for setups with an additional 4th cable for uart flow control
FC_UART_FLWCTL.label: FC_UART_FLWCTL

FC_UART_BAUD.description: RPI HW UART baud rate, needs to match the UART baud rate set on your FC
FC_UART_BAUD.label: FC_UART_BAUD

OHD_UART_EN.description: Enable the full bidirectional Air-to-Ground OpenHD telemetry UART link. Configure the matching UART and baud rate on both units.
OHD_UART_EN.label: OHD_UART_EN

OHD_UART_BAUD.description: Baud rate for the Air-to-Ground OpenHD UART telemetry link. It must match on both units and on any serial radio or bridge between them.
OHD_UART_BAUD.label: OHD_UART_BAUD

OHD_UART_FLW.description: Toggle RTS/CTS flow control for the OpenHD telemetry UART.
OHD_UART_FLW.label: OHD_UART_FLW

SBUS_EN.description: Enable SBUS output on the air unit (generated from RC override messages).
SBUS_EN.label: SBUS_EN

TRACK_UART_BAUD.description: Baud rate for the ground side tracker/output UART.
TRACK_UART_BAUD.label: TRACK_UART_BAUD

TRACK_UART_FLOW.description: Enable RTS/CTS flow control on the ground tracker/output UART.
TRACK_UART_FLOW.label: TRACK_UART_FLOW

UART_PRI_RC.description: Priority bucket for RC/control messages on the OpenHD UART. Higher values are sent first.
UART_PRI_RC.label: UART_PRI_RC

UART_PRI_OHD.description: Priority bucket for OpenHD internal telemetry on the OpenHD UART.
UART_PRI_OHD.label: UART_PRI_OHD

UART_PRI_FC.description: Priority bucket for FC-originating MAVLink on the OpenHD UART.
UART_PRI_FC.label: UART_PRI_FC

CONFIG_BOOT_AIR.description: DEV, change boot as air / ground
CONFIG_BOOT_AIR.label: CONFIG_BOOT_AIR

MULTI_LINK_EN.description: Route video and data over multiple links. Requires a verified enterprise certificate on each OpenHD unit; standard mode uses one link and keeps UART telemetry available.
MULTI_LINK_EN.label: MULTI_LINK_EN

MULTI_LINK_CAP.description: Whether this unit has a verified enterprise certificate permitting multiple links.
MULTI_LINK_CAP.label: MULTI_LINK_CAP

WIFI_MODE.description: Select how the built-in WiFi card is used. OFF disables WiFi entirely, HOTSPOT enables the access point for nearby devices, and CLIENT connects the unit to an existing WiFi network.
WIFI_MODE.label: WIFI_MODE

WIFI_HOTSPOT_E.description: Enable/Disable WiFi hotspot such that you can connect to your air/ground unit via normal WiFi. Frequency is always the opposite of your WB link, e.g. 2.4G if your wb link is 5.8G and opposite. In AUTO (default), the wifi hotspot is automatically disarmed when you arm your FC (to avoid interference).
WIFI_HOTSPOT_E.label: WIFI_HOTSPOT_E

WIFI_IFACES.description: Comma separated list of detected WiFi interfaces and their current roles (wb/hotspot/client/idle).
WIFI_IFACES.label: WIFI_IFACES

WIFI_HS_IFACE.description: Optional interface override to use for hotspot mode (empty = auto). Changing this reconfigures the hotspot when WiFi mode is set to HOTSPOT.
WIFI_HS_IFACE.label: WIFI_HS_IFACE

WIFI_CL_IFACE.description: Optional interface to use for WiFi client mode (empty = auto). Only applied when WiFi mode is set to CLIENT.
WIFI_CL_IFACE.label: WIFI_CL_IFACE

WIFI_CL_SSID.description: SSID to join when WiFi mode is set to CLIENT.
WIFI_CL_SSID.label: WIFI_CL_SSID

WIFI_CL_PW.description: Password to join when WiFi mode is set to CLIENT.
WIFI_CL_PW.label: WIFI_CL_PW

ETH_HOTSPOT_E.description: Enable/Disable ethernet hotspot. When enabled, your rpi becomes a DHCPD server and starts forwarding video & telemetry if you connect a device via ethernet.However, this doesn't allow you to share your other device(s) internet with the RPI (e.g android) and in general, it is recommended to use ETH_PASSIVE_F instead.Cannot be used simultanoeusly with ETH_PASSIVE_F. Requires reboot.
ETH_HOTSPOT_E.label: ETH_HOTSPOT_E

ETH_PASSIVE_F.description: Enable automatic video & telemetry forwarding via ethernet if EITH_HOTSPOT_E is false (Recommended).Cannot be used simultaneously with ETH_HOTSPOT_E. Doesn't require reboot.
ETH_PASSIVE_F.label: ETH_PASSIVE_F

ETHERNET.description: Specify the intended usage of the ground station ethernet port (for connecting external devices). A reboot might be required after changing this param.
ETHERNET.label: ETHERNET

GPIO_2.description: Experimental, allows manually controlling a rpi gpio for special uses like a LED, landing gear, ...
GPIO_2.label: GPIO_2

GPIO_26.description: Experimental, allows manually controlling a rpi gpio for special uses like a LED, landing gear, ...
GPIO_26.label: GPIO_26

FC_UART_CONN.description: Telemetry FC<->Air unit. Make sure FC_UART_BAUD matches your FC. DEFAULT - primary telemetry serial of this platform (see wiki).Otherwise, any linux serial fd filename (dev/testing).
FC_UART_CONN.label: FC_UART_CONN

FC_FW_EVID.description: Evidence supporting the current FC firmware identification. Read only.
FC_FW_EVID.label: FC identification evidence

FC_FW_INFO.description: MAVLink-only firmware family, confidence, version and FC session identity. Read only.
FC_FW_INFO.label: FC firmware identification

TRACKER_UART_OUT.description: Enable mavlink telemetry out via UART on the ground station for connecting a tracker or even an RC with mavlink lua script.
TRACKER_UART_OUT.label: TRACKER_UART_OUT

OHD_UART_TLM.description: UART device used as the full bidirectional OpenHD telemetry link between Air and Ground. Configure the corresponding device on both units.
OHD_UART_TLM.label: OHD_UART_TLM

RC_CHAN_MAP.description: Change which joystick 'channel' is taken for each RC channel. This is a list of numbers, where each number X at position N means take joystick input nr X for channel N. For example, 1,4,... means take channel number 1 for the first channel, and channel number 4 for the second channel. Needs to have ! all! 18 channel elements seperated by a ','
RC_CHAN_MAP.label: RC_CHAN_MAP

RC_UPDATE_HZ.description: Specify the update rate of RC over wifibroadcast. A higher update rate gives lower RC latency, but takes more bandwidth away from the downlink.No effect if joy rc is disabled.
RC_UPDATE_HZ.label: RC_UPDATE_HZ

AUDIO_ENABLE.description: enables / disables audio streaming from air to ground. In development. Use test mode to validate your ground audio output.
AUDIO_ENABLE.label: AUDIO_ENABLE

SYS_RUN_MODE.label: System role
SYS_RUN_MODE.description: Air, Ground, or record-only mode. Applies when OpenHD restarts.

SYS_DEBUG.label: System debug logging
SYS_DEBUG.description: Enable or disable SysUtils debug logging.

SYS_DISP_FORCE.label: Force display mode
SYS_DISP_FORCE.description: Enable the configured display mode, or restore automatic mode selection after reboot.

SYS_DISP_MODE.label: Forced display resolution and refresh rate
SYS_DISP_MODE.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT@HZ, for example 1920x1080@60. Applying a mode also enables forced display mode. Requires reboot.

ARDUCAM_HDR.label: Arducam sensor mode
ARDUCAM_HDR.description: Select experimental three-exposure full-field binned HDR. HDR uses 30 fps and manual exposure; 120 dB has not been measured end-to-end.

ISP_AE_MODE.label: ISP exposure mode
ISP_AE_MODE.description: Automatic shutter and gain are the default in standard video modes, including 720p120. Manual controls remain available. Experimental HDR requires Manual. Applies live; switching to the custom manual 120 fps readout may briefly pause video.

ISP_AE_PROFILE.label: Auto exposure profile
ISP_AE_PROFILE.description: Normal: native automatic exposure. Sport: native Sports scene and a 2 ms shutter cap to reduce motion blur. Fly: 4 ms shutter cap, native backlight scene and lower-image exposure feedback, allowing a bright sky to clip. Fly is experimental and awaits outdoor validation. Profiles apply live without restarting capture; retained while Manual is selected.

ISP_EXPOSURE_US.label: ISP exposure (us)
ISP_EXPOSURE_US.description: Manual ISP shutter request in microseconds; applies live. This experimental profile limits exposure to 4 ms.

ISP_GAIN.label: ISP gain (%)
ISP_GAIN.description: Manual ISP gain, 100 percent is unity. Applies live without restarting video.

ISP_WB_AUTO.label: Automatic white balance
ISP_WB_AUTO.description: Enable ISP automatic white balance. Disable to apply the saved manual Kelvin temperature.

ISP_WB_K.label: Color temperature (K)
ISP_WB_K.description: Manual ISP white-balance temperature in Kelvin, active while automatic white balance is off.

ISP_GAMMA.label: ISP gamma (%)
ISP_GAMMA.description: ISP gamma control: zero selects sRGB; other values are percentages of S3.12 unity. Applies live.

ARDUCAM_HDR_INFO.label: Arducam HDR status
ARDUCAM_HDR_INFO.description: HDR implementation and validation limits supplied by the camera backend.

advanced_mode.switch: Advanced > OSD > DEV > Enable advanced settings

effects.effect: Disable all hidden/whitelist filtering in parameter models, including per-card TX power and CARD_TYPE_* diagnostics. Actual rows still depend on parameters reported by Air, Ground and each camera.
Expose SENSOR_MODE and LIBCAMERA_IMPL camera rows when reported.
Expose the separate frame-rate selector in the resolution editor.
Extend Air and Ground power sliders to 150%.
Expose ESP analysis, FHSS controls and link usage diagnostics, subject to parameter availability.
Instantiate Show Retransmission Stats widget control.

advanced_mode.note: These separate switches are not automatically enabled by Enable advanced settings. MavlinkParamEditor.qml contains a legacy Advanced button but has no current QML instantiation; AIR/GROUND use InlineMavlinkParamControl.

coverage.firmware_discovery_basis: Literal Setting/read-only declarations and uniquely resolved constants in adjacent OpenHD source. This is discovery evidence, not a complete runtime metadata export. Callback-generated IDs and platform-specific overrides may add more.
coverage.exact_device_tree_requires: Air/Ground/camera parameter and metadata exports from the actual connected firmware. Advanced mode exposes reported parameters; it cannot create unsupported settings.
